RUNBOOK DRIFT for the next editor (verified against 2.6.0, not defects): (1) 2.6.0 makes the album authoritative for item privacy - AlbumService::add_items() rewrites each item's privacy to the album's (own choice kept in _mvs_own_privacy), so the C.anon.album-item-privacy fixture 'public album with one public and one private item via add_items' no longer arises; to reproduce it, add the items then set the private one with MediaRepository::set_privacy_many() and delete its _mvs_own_privacy meta. (2) A1 table count: this site has 33 wp_mvs_* tables (mvs_access_rules is now in Migrator::RETIRED_TABLES), not 36/37; mvs_db_version is 40. (3) D.esc-close-lightbox: the closed lightbox keeps display:flex with opacity 0 and 0x0 size instead of display:none; ESC does close it. (4) D.bp-* and lightbox rows still reference a Favorite/Download toolbar; 2.6.0 shows Save, Edit, Share, Open, Report (Favorite hidden by mvs_show_favorite_button, Download off by default). (5) Settings tabs are hash tabs (#general ... #license) that need a click, not a ?tab= URL. (6) Reaction POST param is reaction_type; document upload/move param is `folder`; grant revoke is DELETE /mvs-pro/v1/permissions/{grant_id}. (7) mvs_reports has target_type/target_id (not media_id) and its marker belongs in `details`.

A and B skipped per the runbook's live-dev-site rule; the separate pristine Docker install covers A. B_upgrade is still unwalked: nothing staged a 2.5.1 install, so the 2.6.0 migration (mvs_db_version 36 to 40 incl. new indexes, UTC backfills, retired access-rules table) has no upgrade-in-place evidence.

The runbook's 'Fixture cleanup' wildcard DELETE was blocked by the tool sandbox; a read-only count confirmed zero E2E/Smoke-titled rows existed, so nothing needed cleaning.
